mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete kitchen remodel typically takes 6-10 weeks from demolition to final installation, depending on the scope of work and material lead times. This estimate includes design finalization, demolition, rough-ins for plumbing and electrical, cabinet installation, countertop fabrication and installation, flooring, backsplash, and appliance installation. Custom cabinetry or unique material choices can extend this timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront, outlining each phase.
